# Indicators

This area groups specific metrics and performance measures used to evaluate healthcare outcomes and quality within the Danish clinical database system. It currently covers clinical quality indicators that track surgical outcomes, such as mortality rates following acute surgery for patients without comorbidities. The child folders detail the exact statistical findings, inclusion parameters, and exclusion criteria applied in national clinical databases to monitor these outcomes.

## Pages

- [[entities/indicators/clinical-quality-indicators/index|Clinical Quality Indicators]] — Specific metrics used to measure and evaluate surgical outcomes, including 30-day mortality rates and detailed exclusion criteria for national clinical databases.
